items.q: What should I include in my first enquiry?
items.a: A brief company introduction, the markets and sectors you serve, and the cooperation you want to explore. Use the optional business details section for a company profile link or meeting preference. Clear information helps the team prepare a relevant response.

items.q: Can I request a proposal or an introductory meeting?
items.a: Yes. Mention your request in the cooperation field. The team will review your requirements and discuss an appropriate next step. A meeting date is confirmed separately.

items.q: Does a partnership enquiry create an agreement?
items.a: No. The enquiry starts a discussion. Partnership terms and onboarding are confirmed separately after review.

items.q: Can I submit candidates through this form?
items.a: Please use the official application process or your existing partner portal. This form is for business enquiries.

items.q: How will the team contact me?
items.a: Provide an email address you monitor. The team will contact you to discuss your requirements and, where appropriate, arrange an introductory meeting.
We support candidates across unskilled, semi-skilled, and technical/engineering workforce categories — matched to employer requirements and institutional standards.
A valid passport, CV, educational records, professional credentials, police clearance, and medical checks. Our team reviews your dossier and guides you through any gaps.
We are headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with regional hubs in the UAE and across Africa, and a global network reaching Europe, Canada, Australia, South Korea, New Zealand, the USA and beyond.

items.q: How does Vertex work with agencies and employers?
items.a: We collaborate with recruitment agencies, manpower suppliers, travel agencies, and visa consultancies on sourcing, screening, documentation, and shared deployment workflows — reducing time-to-fill and administrative friction.

items.q: What compliance standards does Vertex follow?
items.a: Our Quality Management approach is aligned with ISO 9001:2015. We operate under UK corporate governance, with anti-bribery, anti-corruption, modern slavery and anti-human trafficking safeguards built into every placement.

web.ending.text: Whether you're an employer, a licensed agency, a travel or visa partner, or a candidate ready to pursue opportunities abroad — Vertex provides the institutional platform to move forward.
